metadata.description: Project name used in resource naming. Lowercase, 3-10 chars.
Deployment environment name used in resource naming.
Azure region for the primary deployment.
Object ID of an administrator to grant Key Vault Administrator access. Leave empty to skip.
Whether to deploy Azure Front Door Premium with WAF protection.
Origin hostname for Front Door when deployFrontDoor is true.
Additional Azure regions for Azure Container Registry replicas.
Secondary region for Log Analytics replication.
Address space for the virtual network.
Address prefix for the private endpoints subnet.
Address prefix for the Container Apps infrastructure subnet (min /23).
Address prefix for the general workload subnet.
Secondary region for Log Analytics workspace replication.
Retention in days for the Log Analytics workspace.
Email receivers for the action group. Each item: { name, email }.
Additional Azure regions for geo-replication (Premium SKU only).
Log Analytics workspace ID for diagnostics.
Principal ID of an admin to grant Key Vault Administrator. Empty to skip.
Principal ID of the app managed identity to grant Key Vault Secrets User.
Application Insights connection string to store as a Key Vault secret.
Resource ID of the virtual network to link.
Subnet ID hosting the private endpoints.
Map of private DNS zone IDs from the privateDns module.
Resource ID of the Azure Container Registry.
Deploy the environment as internal-only (no public ingress).
Origin host name without the https:// prefix.
Name of the deployment script resource.
Resource ID of the user-assigned managed identity used to run the script.
Secret name expected to exist in the Key Vault.

properties.scriptContent:
set -eu
      echo "Verifying Key Vault $KV_NAME and secret $SECRET_NAME..."
      az keyvault show --name "$KV_NAME" --query "properties.provisioningState" -o tsv
      az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name "$SECRET_NAME" --query "id" -o tsv
      echo "Verification passed."
